summary: Regression pass after code-quality cleanup (empty catch fills, memoized SoundContext value / TOAST_OPTIONS, list-key changes). Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass. Extended backend_test.py with a new TestCashback class covering /api/cashback/status shape, 400 on new-user claim, and a full Private-tier payout flow (net-loss set in Mongo -> /auth/me auto-grants cashback and returns one-time cashback_just_paid, subsequent claim returns 400, second /auth/me omits cashback_just_paid, status returns seconds_left > 0 = 7-day cooldown). Frontend smoke: landing shows 'Wages of War' branding, hero coin, giveaway countdown + Nexus banner render; banner click routes to /fleet-sales which renders content. ENLIST dialog registers a new user (10000 credits). Lobby /lobby renders 6 elite slot cards + Keno + Coinflip entrypoints. Opening Gates of Glory (/slots/gates_of_glory) shows the 5x3 grid, SPIN animates the reels, balance updates 10,000 -> 9,910 (bet 100) and 'WIN +10 credits' toast shows. Keno (/keno) has keno-play-btn; Coinflip (/coinflip) has coinflip-flip-btn. Mute toggle in header (nav-mute-btn) toggles cleanly. 'War of Wages' typo NEVER appears anywhere. Only console noise is two expected 401s from /api/auth/me pre-login.

issues: Giveaway countdown currently reads 'EXTRACTION IN PROGRESS / DRAWING NOW' because the target date has been reached in this environment. Not a regression – reflects real state – but consider extending target date or exposing a fresh 'next draw' target so the countdown visibly ticks in demos.

action_items: OPTIONAL (from iter 1, still true): NAV.wallet ('nav-wallet') exported in casino.js but not attached in Layout – reachable via nav-balance chip / user-menu instead.
OPTIONAL: Update GiveawayCountdown target date so it visibly ticks; currently past-target so it shows DRAWING NOW.
critical_code_review_comments: adjust_balance() still updates biggest_win via read-then-write; race under concurrent spins persists – switch to $max operator.
server.py at 793 lines – past the 700 threshold. Split payments and cashback into separate routers/modules for maintainability.

cashback grant on every /auth/me call performs an update+transaction insert when payable – fine functionally, but the same code path also runs on the /cashback/claim POST, so a race between the two could double-grant. Consider a $currentDate/$setOnInsert style atomic guard on last_cashback_at.
SoundContext value + TOAST_OPTIONS memoization looks correct; no behavioural changes detected in regression.

public_user cashback_just_paid field is only returned once (server does not persist it) – logic depends on grant_cashback returning None on second call due to updated last_cashback_at – verified passing in tests.
